SSD endurance, TBW, and sustained writes.

How to interpret flash endurance and write performance for your workload.

01

TBW is a warranty rating

Terabytes written states an allowed write volume under the warranty terms. It is not a countdown to immediate failure and should be compared for the exact capacity.

02

Burst speed is not sustained speed

A drive may write quickly to a cache, then slow during a long transfer. Controller, NAND type, temperature, free space, and workload determine sustained behavior.

03

Match evidence to use

Everyday systems, video scratch disks, databases, and write-heavy workstations have different needs. Check independent sustained tests, warranty terms, power-loss behavior, and backup strategy.

Sources and verification

Use the exact product manuals and support lists linked from each catalog record. Industry specifications are maintained by organizations such as PCI-SIG, JEDEC, and NVM Express. Product implementations can be narrower than an industry standard.
